jobs.occupation: Senior Product Development Engineer
jobs.description:
**Senior Development Engineer, VELUX Products & Innovation – Maintenance Free Window Modules – LKR Innovation House - Østbirk

****Join a team of passionate engineers and technical specialists with end-to-end responsibility for critical window modules. If you thrive on solving complex technical challenges, driving product development, and creating value across the entire product lifecycle, you could be our next Senior Development Engineer.

****Meet your future team

**You will become part of the Maintenance Free Window Modules team based in Østbirk. The team has end-to-end responsibility for VELUX sash and frame mo-dules made from polyurethane and other polymers, as well as our Insulating Glass Unit (IGU) modules.

Working across the full product lifecycle, the team supports everything from concept creation and new product introduction to continuous optimization of cost, performance, sustainability, and quality. We collaborate closely with Product Management, Production, and other development teams to ensure our products continue to create value for customers and the business.

As our new Senior Development Engineer, you will act as the Module Owner of the IGU module area, driving development activities, shaping future module roadmaps, and ensuring strong cross-functional alignment across the organization.

**What We Offer

**This is an opportunity to take on a highly influential technical role with significant impact across products, processes, and stakeholders. You will work with experienced colleagues in an international environment where innovation, knowledge sharing, and collaboration are valued and encouraged.

More specifically your tasks will be to:

• Hold technical ownership and end-to-end responsibility for Insulating Glass Unit (IGU) modules.

• Drive module development activities across new product launches, performance improvements, cost optimization, upgrades, sustainability initiatives, and quality enhancements.

• Conduct module health assessments to evaluate performance, value creation, business relevance, and future opportunities.

• Identify, qualify, and drive opportunities that create value across the product lifecycle and value chain.

• Lead design, concept development, and resolution of complex technical challenges.

• Define and secure technical requirements, module performance, and robust engineering solutions.

• Build strong relationships with stakeholders and ensure alignment across Product Management, Production, Supply Chain, and Product Development.

• Support management decision-making through technical expertise and insights.

• Act as a knowledge leader by developing technical capabilities, facilitating learning activities, and promoting effective knowledge sharing throughout the organization.

**What You Will Bring

**You enjoy navigating complex technical environments and are motivated by combining deep technical expertise with cross-functional collaboration. You take ownership, communicate clearly, and are able to balance technical excellence with business value.

Moreover, we expect that you:

• Hold a Master’s degree in Engineering or another relevant technical discipline.

• Have experience working with product development or complex technical products.

• Possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a structured approach to technical challenges.

• Have experience with CAD tools, preferably CREO and Windchill.

• Communicate fluently in English, both verbally and in writing.

• Demonstrate the ability to engage and align stakeholders across functions and disciplines.

• Take a proactive approach and can independently drive activities from concept to implementation.

• Have experience or knowledge into systems engineering, which is considered an advantage but not a requirement.

• Have experience or knowledge within insulating glass, glazing solutions, or related technologies, which is considered an advantage but not a requirement.

**Ready to apply?

**Learn more about the VELUX Group online at www.velux.com where you can read more about working at our company and what to expect of our recruitment process.

We look forward to receiving your application and CV as soon as possible. We are conducting interviews on an ongoing basis until we have found the right match.

All inquiries will be treated confidentially.

**About VELUX

**In the VELUX Group, we offer you a world of opportunities and the chance to create a bright future. From the forefront of the roof window category, we enable those who live, work and play under the roof transform their spaces and live a healthier everyday life with more daylight and fresh air.

The VELUX Group is an international, family-owned business with strong financial roots and each year we can create real impact by reinvesting in society, our employees and planet through our foundations. With 20 production companies in 12 countries and sales companies in 37 countries, our products are widely available. We employ around 12,000 people, and our company is headquartered in Denmark. Alongside the rest of our values, courage and mutual respect define our actions every day and how we wish to contribute to the world.

**Equal Opportunity Employer

**At VELUX Residential, we believe in fostering a diverse workplace for everyone to thrive, develop, and perform at their best, and where you feel welcome, respected, and valued. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all, whether you are applying for a role or already a part of VELUX Residential. That means we recruit, hire, train, and promote people based on their skills and potential without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, neurodiversity, disability, protected veteran status, national origin, sexual orientation, or any other basis prohibited by applicable law.

We value diversity and strive to ensure that our employment decisions are fair and inclusive, focusing only on what truly matters: your qualifications and how you can contribute to our shared mission and success.

jobs.occupation: Group Treasury Manager
jobs.description:
**Join Group Treasury at our headquarters in Faxe

**As part of our Group Treasury team, you will play a central role in managing the Group's treasury activities and supporting strategic financial decision-making. The Group Treasury-team reports directly to Executive Management and works closely with other headquarters functions, subsidiaries, and our Shared Service Centre in Lithuania. The position is based at our headquarters in Faxe.

**A Key Role with Broad Responsibility

****Responsibilities

**As Treasury Manager, you will work across a wide range of treasury disciplines, combining operational execution with strategic analysis. Your responsibilities will include:

• Preparing and maintaining the weekly Group cash flow forecast, including follow-up with subsidiaries to support liquidity planning and working capital initiatives.

• Managing Group cash management activities, including daily optimization of liquidity positions and continuous development of the Group's banking structure.

• Monitoring and reporting financial risks, including foreign exchange, commodity, and interest rate exposures, and providing hedging recommendations in line with the Group Treasury Policy.

• Executing transactions in aluminum, gas, foreign exchange, and interest rate swaps.

• Preparing and reporting the Group's financial items on a monthly, quarterly, and annual basis.

• Conducting ad hoc analyses related to financial risks, bank debt, performance, and other treasury-related topics.

• Supporting the management of the Group's insurance program.

In addition, you will act as a trusted financial specialist across the organization, supporting colleagues with treasury and finance-related questions. You will also contribute to managing banking relationships, funding activities, and the ongoing development of treasury operations and strategic initiatives.

**Our Culture

**We believe in freedom with responsibility. Our leadership style is built on trust, accountability, and collaboration. Team members are empowered to take ownership of their responsibilities while knowing support is always available when needed.

We also value a healthy work-life balance and strive to create an environment where people can perform at their best while maintaining flexibility and well-being.

**Why Join Us?

**This is an exciting career opportunity that will give you direct exposure to Executive Management in a listed company. You will have the opportunity to influence business decisions through insightful analysis, sound financial recommendations, and proactive risk management.

You will join an ambitious organization with a strong market position and a dynamic growth agenda. The role offers significant responsibility, professional challenges, and varied tasks within a highly capable and collaborative team. You will also build a broad network across the organization and benefit from excellent career and development opportunities.

**Your Profile

****We Are Looking For a Candidate Who Brings

**

• A minimum of 3 years of relevant experience within treasury, finance, banking, or a related field.

• A university degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a similar discipline (e.g., MSc in Finance, Economics, or equivalent).

• Strong analytical capabilities and a solid understanding of treasury processes and financial instruments.

• A commercial mindset with the ability to translate financial insights into practical business solutions.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

**In Addition, You

**

• Are advanced Excel user with a strong interest in financial systems and technology.

• Have experience with treasury management systems; SAP experience is considered an advantage.

• Are fluent in English, written and spoken.

**Personal Qualities

**You enjoy balancing deep analytical work with hands-on operational responsibilities and thrive in a role with broad organizational interaction. You are ambitious, curious, and confident in challenging established ways of working. At the same time, you bring positive energy, resilience, and a collaborative approach to your work.

**Does this sound like you?

**If you are motivated by combining analytical depth with business impact, and you thrive in a collaborative environment where ideas quickly turn into action, then you may be the colleague we're looking for. We look forward to receiving your application.

At Royal Unibrew, you'll find the industry's most dedicated, energetic, and experienced colleagues. Together, we build the best framework for a job that precisely matches your everyday life and career aspirations.

Royal Unibrew produces, markets, sells, and distributes quality beverages. We are a consortium of more than 35 breweries and beverage producers from across Denmark, known especially for our traditional, locally-rooted brands such as Faxe Kondi, Egekilde, Royal Beer, Ceres, and Odense Pilsner, as well as partner brands like Pepsi MAX and Heineken.

Today, we are the second-largest beverage company in Denmark. Our journey began in 1856, and we still maintain a strong commercial focus, a clear growth strategy, and an ambitious sustainability strategy - both domestically and internationally.

You'll have over 1500 colleagues in Denmark and more than 2700 colleagues outside the country, including in Finland, Italy, France, Norway, Canada, the Netherlands, and the Baltic countries.

With us, you'll be part of challenging the boundaries of sustainable production and distribution. You'll help ensure a diverse range of beverages that bring people together - on the dance floor, during the third half, or over a meal - all while contributing to strengthening Danish sports, music, and community life.

jobs.occupation: Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Project Manager – Operations

****Location: Lyngby, Denmark

**Do you have a proven track record of turning complex operational challenges into tangible results? Are you motivated by getting close to manufacturing operations, analysing performance and working with teams to implement improvements that make a measurable difference?

We are looking for a Project Manager who combines strong analytical and problem-solving capability with the drive, resilience and hands-on approach required to deliver outcomes in complex manufacturing environments.

If you enjoy taking ownership, solving difficult problems and seeing your work translate into improved operational performance, this could be your next career move.

**The position

**As a Project Manager, you will work as part of our internal operations and manufacturing consulting team, delivering complex improvement, operational readiness and ramp up projects across our global manufacturing network.

This is not a traditional PMO or project coordination role.

You will be expected to get close to the operation, spend time on the shop floor, understand what is really happening within the production environment and use data and structured problem-solving to identify opportunities for improvement.

More importantly, your responsibility does not end when the solution has been identified. You will work alongside manufacturing teams and stakeholders to turn recommendations into actions and deliver tangible operational outcomes.

Our projects are typically intensive assignments, with project teams substantially dedicated to one project at a time. Assignments will often run for six to twelve months and can sometimes continue for longer.

**Your Key Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Taking ownership of project workstreams and operational improvement initiatives from diagnosis through to implementation and delivery.

• Driving operational readiness and ramp-up of new production lines, helping manufacturing operations achieve stable target performance.

• Working directly with manufacturing sites and shop-floor teams to understand operational challenges and identify bottlenecks, losses and improvement opportunities.

• Analysing operational performance data and developing capacity models, process maps and improvement scenarios.

• Translating complex analysis into clear recommendations, practical implementation roadmaps and measurable actions.

• Driving implementation and following improvements through to tangible operational outcomes.

• Working with production teams to establish sustainable changes in performance and ways of working.

• Collaborating with stakeholders across manufacturing, engineering, quality, supply chain and site leadership.

• Influencing stakeholders and maintaining momentum when implementation is challenging or priorities change.

• Communicating progress, risks, recommendations and outcomes clearly to relevant stakeholders and project leadership.

This is a hands on role. You should be comfortable moving between analytical problem-solving and the realities of implementation on the manufacturing shop floor.

The position is based in Lyngby, Denmark, and requires flexibility for up to 50% global travel.

Travel requirements will depend on project assignment and may change throughout a project. The ability and willingness to travel flexibly according to business and project requirements is therefore an essential requirement of the position.

**Qualifications

**We are looking for someone who can demonstrate a proven track record of delivering outcomes, rather than simply participating in projects.

You combine strong intellectual and analytical capability with the practical judgement, resilience and persistence required to turn ideas into results.

**To Succeed In This Role, You

**

• Hold a relevant degree in engineering, science, business administration, economics or another relevant discipline.

• Have relevant professional experience within areas such as manufacturing, operational excellence, operations consulting, engineering, supply chain, procurement or complex cross-functional project work.

• Can demonstrate a proven track record of taking ownership and delivering tangible outcomes through projects, operational improvements or complex cross-functional initiatives.

• Demonstrate strong analytical and structured problem-solving capability.

• Are comfortable personally analysing operational data and using it to identify performance gaps, bottlenecks and improvement opportunities.

• Can translate analysis into practical recommendations and then follow those recommendations through implementation.

• Are comfortable working hands-on with manufacturing sites and shop-floor teams.

• Can operate effectively in complex and ambiguous environments where the solution may not initially be obvious.

• Demonstrate strong stakeholder management, collaboration and communication skills.

• Have the resilience and persistence to continue driving change when implementation is difficult or initial solutions do not deliver the expected results.

• Are professionally proficient in English.

• Are able and willing to travel globally for up to 50% of your time according to project requirements.

Relevant experience from operations or management consulting can be particularly valuable, including experience gained within operational practices or projects.

We are also interested in candidates from complex manufacturing environments such as pharmaceuticals, automotive, aerospace and FMCG, particularly where you have worked with operational improvement, production ramp-up, manufacturing performance or Lean ways of working.

Pharmaceutical manufacturing, GMP and validation experience are advantageous but are not essential.

Experience working within a Lean manufacturing environment can also be beneficial. Formal Lean certification is not required.

Likewise, formal project management qualifications such as PMP or PRINCE2 are not a requirement. We place greater emphasis on your demonstrated ability to structure problems, work with people, take ownership and deliver measurable outcomes.

**About The Department

**You will join Drug Product Manufacturing Excellence, a global unit responsible for driving performance improvements, operational readiness and transformation across Novo's manufacturing network.

The team operates as an internal operations and manufacturing consultancy, supporting our manufacturing organisation with complex operational challenges.

Our colleagues bring diverse professional backgrounds, including operations and management consulting, Novo manufacturing and support functions, and industries such as automotive, aerospace and FMCG.

What brings the team together is the ability to combine analytical problem-solving with hands-on implementation.

Our projects can include operational readiness and ramp-up of new production lines, improving capacity and performance within existing operations and solving complex cross-functional manufacturing challenges.

Rather than managing several projects simultaneously, our project teams are typically substantially dedicated to one assignment, allowing them to work closely with the operation and remain involved from diagnosis through to implementation.

As a Project Manager, you will have meaningful ownership within these assignments and will be expected to demonstrate that your work ultimately translates into operational outcomes.

The role provides significant exposure to different manufacturing environments, functions and senior stakeholders across our global organisation and offers opportunities to progress towards increasingly complex project and leadership responsibilities.

**Working at Novo

**Every day we seek the solutions that defeat serious chronic diseases. To do this, we approach our work with determination, constant curiosity and a commitment to finding better ways forward. For over 100 years, this dedication has driven us to build a company focused on lasting change for long-term health. One where diverse thinking, shared purpose and mutual respect come together to create extraordinary results. When you join us, you're not just starting a job – you're becoming part of a story that spans generations.

**What We Offer

**There is, of course, more on offer here than the uniqueness of our culture and the extraordinary results we produce. Being part of a global healthcare company means opportunities to learn and develop are all around us, while our benefits are designed with your career and life stage in mind.

**Salary And Benefits

**Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 651,000 to 956,900 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate's skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

**Incentives And Benefits

**The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

**More information

**Please apply in English and refrain from adding a photo to your CV to ensure fair and efficient processing.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

At Novo, we recognise that it is no longer good enough to aspire to be the best company in the world. We need to aspire to be the best company for the world and we know that this is only possible with talented employees with diverse perspectives, backgrounds and cultures. We are therefore committed to creating an inclusive culture that celebrates the diversity of our employees, the patients we serve and communities we operate in. Together, we're life changing.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

jobs.description:
**Minimum qualifications:

**

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

• Experience in diagnosing and troubleshooting operating systems and computer/server hardware or networking protocols.

• Experience with performing component-level repairs on IT equipment.

• Ability to lift/move 50lb (23kg) of equipment and to exert physically over extended periods of time, including frequent bending, kneeling, climbing, pushing/pulling and lifting.

• Must have the ability to work non-standard hours, including weekends, holidays and on shift-based schedule as required.

**Preferred qualifications:

**

• Certification in online Google IT Support Professional Certificate program.

• 2 years of experience in diagnosing and troubleshooting operating systems and computer/server hardware or networking protocols.

• Experience in working within a data center or network operation center environment.

• Ability to collaborate and partner with teams to overcome tests.

• Ability to adapt to changes in a changing work environment.

**About The Job

**Google isn't just a software company. The Hardware Operations team is responsible for monitoring the state-of-the-art physical infrastructure behind Google's powerful search technology. As an Operations Technician, you'll install, configure, test, troubleshoot and maintain hardware (like servers and its components) and server software (like Google's Linux cluster). You'll also take on the configuration of more complex components such as networks, routers, hubs, bridges, switches and networking protocols. You'll participate in or lead small project teams on larger installations and develop project contingency plans. A typical day involves manual movement and installation of racks, and while it can sometimes be physically demanding, you are excited to work with infrastructure that is at the cutting-edge of computer technology.

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

• Report issues and follow data center procedures to troubleshoot and diagnose straightforward issues with equipment or infrastructure as they arise, and apply the resources needed to resolve identified issues.

jobs.occupation: Director, Team Lead Late-Stage CMC Project Management
jobs.description:
At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

At Genmab, we’re committed to building extra[not]ordinary futures together, by developing antibody products and pioneering, knock-your-socks-off therapies that change the lives of patients and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. From our people who are caring, candid, and impact-driven to our business, which is innovative and rooted in science, we believe that being proudly unique, determined to be our best, and authentic is essential to fulfilling our purpose.

**The Role and Department

**The Late Stage CMC Project organization is growing and we are looking for 2 Directors to lead and develop a team of Project Managers in Genmab’s late-stage CMC project organization.

The roles have similar responsibility and you will combine people leadership with strategic oversight and hands-on responsibility for complex CMC programs, including contribution to governance of outsourced activities with contract development and manufacturing organizations (CDMOs).

Both postions report to the Senior Director, Head of the Late-Stage Project Management Office, within Genmab Tech Ops in Denmark. Working closely with CMC, Regulatory Affairs, Quality and Supply Chain, you will align CMC delivery with development priorities and drive progress towards regulatory submission and commercial readiness.

You will help shape the late-stage project organization, develop experienced Project Managers and translate portfolio priorities into clear decisions and reliable delivery.

**Responsibilities

**Team leadership and development

• Lead and develop your team through resource planning, recruitment, performance management and succession planning, building capabilities for current and future portfolio needs

• Coach Project Managers in strategic thinking, cross-functional leadership and resolving complex CMC challenges. Set clear expectations, delegate effectively and build accountability for results

• Work closely with the Senior Director to prioritize resources and budgets across the team’s programs, resolve capacity constraints and align delivery with portfolio objectives

CMC strategy and project responsibilities

• Shape CMC strategies with technical and functional leads, aligned with overall Drug Development Plans. Lead assigned programs through integrated planning, budget analysis and management of cross-program dependencies.

• Drive cross-functional delivery of technology transfer, process validation, manufacturing readiness and submission documentation, with clear ownership and adherence to Genmab’s quality system and applicable regulatory requirements

• Ensure reliable plans, risk and decision logs, and executive reporting. Anticipate portfolio impacts, resolve high-impact issues and facilitate data-driven options and recommendations to senior governance forums

• Lead improvements to the Project Manual, governance and ways of working, including digital and AI-enabled tools that strengthen planning, risk management and delivery

**CDMO collaboration and project governance

**

• Representing Late Stage CMC Project Management in CDMO joint project and steering committees, facilitating strategic discussions and decisions within delegated authority. Ensure decisions translate into clear commitments and follow-through

• Shape outsourcing and partnership strategies with relevant functions, aligning proposals, contracts and quality agreements with program objectives, business needs and intellectual property considerations

• Hold partners accountable for agreed scope, quality, timelines and budgets. Build transparent relationships, resolve vendor conflicts and escalate strategic trade-offs and risks with clear recommendations

**Requirements

**

• Master’s degree or higher in natural sciences, pharmacy, engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent experience

• Extensive biopharmaceutical CMC experience, including late-stage biologics development and progression towards commercial supply. Experience with antibody-drug conjugates is an advantage

• Proven experience shaping strategies and leading complex global CMC programs, including portfolio prioritization, strategic budget management and cross-functional risk resolution

• Established people-leadership experience, with a track record of developing Project Managers, building team capabilities and supporting talent and succession planning

• Strong understanding of technology transfer, process validation, submission strategies and the interdependencies between development, manufacturing and supply

• Experience shaping outsourcing strategies, leading CDMO governance and resolving complex partner issues with sound business judgment

• Advanced knowledge of GMP and global CMC regulatory expectations, including those relevant to FDA, EMA and NMPA submissions

• Excellent English communication skills, with a track record of influencing senior stakeholders and translating complex issues into clear business recommendations.

**About You

**You combine strategic perspective with the judgment to know when to engage directly and when to empower others. You develop people, set clear priorities and make well-founded decisions under uncertainty, balancing quality, timelines and cost.

You build trust across functions and cultures, challenge assumptions constructively and create an inclusive environment where colleagues take ownership. You champion a ONE-Team approach, welcome feedback and turn lessons learned into improvements across the project organization.

**Location and Travel

**The role is based in Denmark. Travel is expected to be approximately 10–15 days per year.

Genmab leverages the effectiveness of an agile working environment, when possible, for the betterment of employee work-life balance. Our offices are designed as open, community-based spaces that work to connect our employees. Whether you’re in one of our collaboratively designed office spaces or working remotely, we thrive on connecting with each other to innovate.

The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK883.200,00---1.324.800,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

**Benefits

**When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

jobs.occupation: IT Onsite Specialist
jobs.description:
The IT Onsite Support Specialist provides hands-on Level 2 IT support at assigned business locations, serving as the local extension of Global IT teams. The role is responsible for resolving technical issues that require physical presence, maintaining site technology and operational readiness, managing IT assets, and supporting employee onboarding and offboarding. This position also provides hands-on assistance to Network, Platform, Security, and Workplace teams and coordinates with remote teams and external vendors when additional support is required.

We are looking for a hands-on IT professional who combines strong technical troubleshooting skills with a customer-focused mindset and the ability to work independently in a business environment. The ideal candidate takes ownership of issues, communicates effectively with users and technical teams, and is comfortable working across different areas of IT to deliver reliable onsite support.

Your responsibilities

• Deliver Level 2 onsite support for hardware, software, connectivity, mobile devices, printers, meeting rooms, and workplace technology.

• Resolve incidents and service requests through ServiceNow while meeting established service levels and maintaining clear ticket documentation.

• Maintain site IT readiness by ensuring end-user devices, meeting room technology, printers, network equipment, and other local technology remain operational.

• Execute hands-on activities for Global IT teams, including equipment installation, replacement, troubleshooting, cabling, rack and stack, reboots, and other physical infrastructure activities.

• Manage IT assets and inventory, including receiving, deployment, recovery, stock management, audits, and lifecycle activities.

• Support employee onboarding and offboarding by preparing, deploying, recovering, reimaging, and securing IT equipment.

jobs.description:

jobs.occupation: Senior Integration & Data Architect
jobs.description:
Stibo DX is the company behind Cue, our multimedia enterprise platform used by media organizations around the world to create, manage, and deliver content across digital and print channels.

As Cue evolves from self-hosted and hybrid deployments towards a standardized, cloud-native SaaS platform, the way our platform connects, exchanges data, and governs information is becoming increasingly important. Creating greater consistency across APIs, integrations, events, schemas, and data ownership is therefore one of our key architectural priorities.

As our Senior Integration & Data Architect, you will take ownership of shaping a more unified, governed, and decoupled integration and data architecture across Cue. You will help us tackle fragmentation and inconsistency across the platform and establish clear architectural patterns that enable our product and engineering teams to build and evolve solutions with greater speed and confidence.

This is very much a hands-on architecture role. You will not simply define principles and governance from a distance. You will work directly with teams on real designs, APIs, event contracts, integrations, schemas, and data domains, helping translate architectural direction into solutions that work in practice. You will work with modern architectural approaches and technologies such as API-first design, GraphQL/REST, Kafka, CDC, schema evolution, and multi-tenant SaaS.

You will become part of a small, but senior architecture team with significant autonomy, visibility, and responsibility. Working closely with our Platform Architect, who focuses on runtime, multi-tenancy, and observability, and our Senior Software Architect, who focuses on domain boundaries and solution design, you will have the opportunity to influence how the entire Cue platform develops as we continue our SaaS transformation.

You will report to the Director of Solution Architecture, and you will work within an architecture governance model keeping decisions close to the teams, while applying the right level of architectural guidance based on risk. The role can be based at any of our offices in Aarhus, Copenhagen, Oslo, Málaga, or Hamburg, depending on where you are located.

Key responsibilities

• Define and govern the unified API strategy for CUE (REST and GraphQL), design standards, versioning, deprecation, breaking-change discipline, and consistency across teams.

• Design integration patterns for a modular, microservices-based platform, sync vs async, anti-corruption layers, adapters, and migration from bespoke customer integrations to standardized platform interfaces; guide teams on when to use events vs APIs and how to avoid tight coupling.

• Own event-driven architecture on Kafka, topic design, event contracts, schema evolution, CDC/streaming, and consistency models (ordering, idempotency, replay).

• Establish data domains and governance, ownership models, schema definition and evolution, metadata, lineage, quality, classification, retention, and compliance readiness.

• Align contracts with domain boundaries, connect bounded contexts, domain events, and service ownership to API, event, and data design, in close collaboration with the Software Architect.

• Enable teams through architecture leadership, produce reference architectures and integration blueprints, shepherd ADRs, review high-risk designs, and coach teams on better patterns without blocking delivery.

• Reduce fragmentation and drive consolidation, identify one-off approaches early and steer teams toward reusable platform standards.

• Partner across architecture and delivery, work with platform, product, and engineering teams to ensure standards are usable, adopted, and durable.

What you will bring

You are someone who naturally takes ownership and looks beyond individual solutions to understand what is best for the platform as a whole. You notice fragmentation, inconsistencies, and emerging risks, and you are proactive in bringing people together to find practical ways forward.

You are comfortable working across engineering, architecture, and product, and you know how to turn complex integration and data topics into clear, pragmatic decisions that teams can actually work with. You build credibility through your expertise, but also through collaboration, listening, and an understanding that strong architecture needs to support delivery rather than slow it down.

You believe in strong standards where they matter, while taking a pragmatic, risk-based approach to governance. You are curious and adaptable, care about quality and maintainability, and are motivated by creating clarity around contracts, data ownership, and architectural boundaries. Ultimately, you enjoy bringing coherence to complex platforms and leaving them in a better architectural state than you found them.

Experience

• 10+ years in software engineering, integration engineering, data engineering, or architecture, with 5+ years in a senior role focused on integration, APIs, events, and/or data architecture.

• Proven experience designing and governing APIs in large, distributed, multi-team environments.

• Strong experience with REST and GraphQL API design, versioning, and contract-first approaches.

• Hands-on experience with event-driven architecture in production, preferably Kafka.

• Experience with integration patterns: messaging, pub/sub, request/reply, outbox, saga/process manager, and CDC.

• Strong understanding of schema modeling and schema evolution for APIs and events.

• Experience defining data domains, ownership models, and data governance in a product or platform context.

• Ability to connect Domain-Driven Design (DDD) concepts (bounded contexts, domain events, aggregates) to integration and data design.

• Understanding of AWS, Kubernetes-based platforms, and multi-tenant SaaS implications for data isolation and integration boundaries.

• Security-aware design across APIs and events, authentication, authorization, zero-trust principles.

Interested?

Please apply here on LinkedIn. You are encouraged to apply at your earliest convenience. Short-listed candidates will be invited for an interview. Applications are processed as they are received until the right candidate is found.

Should you have questions about the position, you are also welcome to contact Director, Safdar Aqeel via mail safs@stibodx.com. We look forward to hearing from you.
